video_title: Should You Use Zed? 60-Second IDE Guide
voiceover_script: Looking for the perfect code editor? Today on IDE Guide, we're testing Zed! A high-performance, multi-player code editor written in Rust by the creators of Atom. Pricing model is Free (Open Source). Top strengths include Insanely fast sub-millisecond startup & typing, Built-in multiplayer pair programming. However, keep in mind Ecosystem extensions still maturing. Best suited for Performance purists, Rust, C++, and Go engineers who value speed. Disclaimer: IDE Guide is an independent technical publication. This content is not sponsored, endorsed, or affiliated with any software vendor or editor developer mentioned above. All reviews and assessments are based strictly on objective developer evaluation.
